finding: A09/M4.1 lacked source-backed BTC/ETH/SOL current instrument metadata and cross-asset native precision/Funding/equity-unit acceptance.

source.selection: Exact symbol records selected from the official current response; no historic archive implied.

coverage: Loads tick size, LOT_SIZE step/min quantity, and MIN_NOTIONAL from each current source row.
Checks native base, quote, settlement currencies and instrument precision.
Executes an order at or above exchange minimum notional on all three instruments.
Applies a synthetic funding settlement and reconciles quote-currency adjustment and account equity in USDT.
limitations: Funding event is synthetic; it validates engine unit/sign propagation, not historical funding rates or interval schedules.
Fees are set to zero in the harness; exchangeInfo does not establish user-specific maker/taker fee tiers.
Linear multiplier 1 is the configured base-asset quantity convention; historical instrument rule records still require their effective-date source.
No market-history, account-ledger, Validation, Test, or Holdout payload was read.
status: Current snapshot engineering coverage closed; historical/account economic certification remains open.
